verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own marketing describes a one-click sweep that dismisses non-important emails in bulk, and community users mention a 'mark as done' feature and bulk-archiving. That suggests a bulk-dismiss stroke exists, but nothing documents arbitrary multi-selection of conversations or bulk labeling. Missing for 10: documented multi-select of arbitrary conversations, bulk label action, explicit bulk mark-done/archive docs, and hands-on corroboration of a multi-select workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
Another finds it odd that bulk-archiving emails is equated with productivity.
Tried it and liked the grouping and 'mark as done' feature
